text: Change early stopping from a GAUC-only proxy to the official primary proxy computed as the mean of GAUC and nDCG@5.
rationale: Experiment 1 was selected by a GAUC-only training proxy although official selection averages GAUC and nDCG@5. This is a cheap alignment correction with no feature or scorer change.
exact_ablation: From experiment 1, change only checkpoint selection and patience monitoring from validation within-user GAUC proxy to validation primary proxy equal to 0.5 times within-user GAUC plus 0.5 times nDCG@5; retain data, features, BCE, optimizer, epoch limit, and patience unchanged.

expected_effect.GAUC: -0.001 to +0.001 because the selected epoch may sacrifice some broad ordering.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: 0.000 to +0.003 through selection of a more top-five-effective checkpoint.
